target.outcome: Instantaneous COVID-19 case fatality: deaths back-projected to confirmation day among daily confirmed cases.
target.geography: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland
target.population: Laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 cases among residents of the four UK constituent countries
target.period: Article target 2020-03-26 through 2020-09-15; bounded fitted effective dates 2020-03-26 through 2020-06-22.
target.exposure_assignment: Article: daily country averages. Bounded implementation: Open-Meteo gridded PM2.5 daily means at each national-capital coordinate, summarized over lags 0–10.
target.model: Article Model 6 target is binomial-logit GLMM DLNM. Fitted bounded analogue is binomial GLM with flexible cubic bases of 0–10-day mean PM2.5, temperature and sunshine, plus country and weekday fixed effects.
target.named_outcome_source: Public historical UK nation indicators archive derived from the sources documented in its retained sources file.

substitutions.published: DEFRA Air Information Resource daily country average
substitutions.reanalysis: Open-Meteo gridded daily PM2.5 at each national-capital coordinate
substitutions.reason: Decoded, complete four-location historical public series retained; monitor-boundary feasibility route was also exercised through AERIS.
The recovered four-nation health overlap ends 2020-06-30 and 8-day outcome alignment excludes its trailing days.

substitutions.reanalysis: Reported deaths shifted eight days earlier and capped at daily cases
substitutions.reason: The paper gives a 7.92-day mean delay, but exact delay records/distribution and original outcome data were not recovered.

substitutions.reanalysis: Flexible lag-mean binomial GLM with country/weekday fixed effects
substitutions.reason: Transparent bounded analogue when exact cross-basis/mixed-effect implementation cannot be supported by recovered inputs.

coverage.rule: Retain all country-days with observed positive daily cases, available shifted deaths, and complete 0–10 day environmental histories; no numeric environmental completeness exclusion was imposed.
coverage.notes: 351 fit rows: England 89, Scotland 89, Wales 89, Northern Ireland 84. Raw PM2.5 is complete in every recovered environmental country-day; the five missing Northern Ireland outcome rows explain the asymmetric fit count. See coverage_report.json.

blockers: Not a matched reproduction: environmental support changed from country monitor averages to capital-coordinate gridded values.
Not a full-period reproduction: the retained common four-nation outcome series ends before the article period.
Not exact back-projection or DLNM: retained public inputs support only the documented bounded proxies.

design_provenance.assignment_method: within_boundary_monitor_mean, separately by country and day; retain contributing monitor metadata.
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: daily ambient PM2.5 country mean in µg/m³; raw gaps then article-specified trailing-7-day imputation only in analysis table.

coverage_policy.evidence: report_only: the article supplies no numeric threshold; report raw and imputed coverage.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: This is the first executable exposure-design amendment, preserving the article's administrative country-day pollutant construct while keeping public source selection open pending feasibility probes.
evidence_basis: Article environmental-data methods specify daily pollutant averages for every country and 7-day preceding-average replacement for missing observations.
Article model formulation specifies country-level daily outcomes and a maximum 10-day lag for air pollution.

effects.label: Bounded PM2.5 lag-mean analogue
effects.contrast: PM2.5 19 versus 10 µg/m³ for the fitted 0–10-day lag mean; covariate values held at medians, England/Monday design row.

reported_variants: Article Model 6 target implemented as bounded lag-mean binomial-logit analogue
